note: A permanent guard against the class of bug this corpus found twice. The subject's name arrives as numeric character references (Đorđe Nikolić); an employer carries a Ł; a publication title contains İ, whose lower-case form is two characters and once shifted every parser index after it, silently destroying a page's structured data. Collaborator names — İpek, Yıldırım, Nyström, Müller, O'Connor, D'Souza, Łukasz, Nguyễn — are prose, and must be read as text rather than becoming people. This is a global professional identity system; a name matcher that only recognises ASCII does not fail politely, it confidently misidentifies someone.
